sloka: ततः सा शापदोषेण पुरूरवसमभ्यगात् ।प्रतियाते पुरूरवं बुधस्यात्मजमौरसम् ।। ७.५६.२६ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ sā śāpadoṣeṇa purūravasamabhyagāt ।pratiyāte purūravaṁ budhasyātmajamaurasam ।। 7.56.26 ॥

translations.english: Then she, by the effect of the curse, went to Pururavas, the legitimate son of Budha, who had returned.
